text.p: These are the leading stories in Zambia's newspapers on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The examination council has doubled fees for primary and secondary school exams.
- Some Zairean refugees trickling into Zambia are being offered visas by local immigration officers, Finance Minister Ronald Penza said.
- The civil war in Zaire has now moved to less than 140 km from Zambia's Kaputa border.
- Maize meal prices may rise soon as supplies dwindle, the Weekly Market Bulletin said.
- The minister of education told parlaiment the education sector is in a crisis due to a shortage of money.
